title: Decide with Jev: Tie Every AI Check to the Exact Draft
content:
If a draft changes after an AI check, the old result can still look current. In episode 4 of Decide with Jev, we tie every check to the exact text it looked at. The editor's decision is stored on its own, right next to the model's answer.

The post Decide with Jev: Tie Every AI Check to the Exact Draft appeared first on Laravel News.
